svg.title: fig. 51 — Everything is one step from a bank
svg.text: 533 firms in the sector · 3,684 one step out · 1,549 two
530 firms in the sector · 2,914 one step out · 2,187 two

g.text: one, two or three steps out

The 5,989 firms of the interlock graph, placed by how many steps they sit from a sector's boards: the sector at the centre, one band per step. Radii come from cumulative firm counts — area is proportional to the

number of firms — so the blue line falls where the share of the network reachable in one step ends. Finance on the left (533 firms), mining on the right (530), almost exactly the same size: 70.4% of the network against
57.5%. Same result as the removal tests, in geometry. The edges are a sample of centre-to-first-band ties (900 of 79,072) and are there as texture only.
